aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source evidence for a temperature dry-box validation but grouping and outcome extraction need correction.
issues: Baseline/test condition is ambiguous because Normal 120 and Test 120 are mixed.
Function outcome omits the 180C result row and is not fully compared.
Tension results lose inherited temperature for Suspension B subgroup rows.
Function rows and a header row are incorrectly treated as measurement stats.
Changed-factor domain and title are too generic or misleading.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Test 120C be treated as the same baseline as Normal 120C across all sections?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to dry-box temperature condition for Frame+SP.
Use 120C baseline consistently or flag label ambiguity.
Keep frame deform, tension, and function as outcomes under the same temperature comparison.
Add function 180C row and remove header/function rows from measurement stats.
Propagate temperature to Suspension B rows and keep suspension as subgroup context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are citeable but not yet sufficient because key rows are omitted and some cited rows are misclassified.
